abstract: A radioimmunoassay was performed with monoclonal antibody 1E5, which distinguishes free beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin in the presence of intact human chorionic gonadotrophin. Serum samples were obtained from 68 pregnant women, 9 with hydatidiform mole who underwent spontaneous remission, 12 with hydatidiform mole who developed gestational trophoblastic disease, 5 with metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease of high-risk category, and 1 with choriocarcinoma concomitant with pregnancy. The concentrations of free beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin and total beta-subunit were determined on the sera. The assay data were expressed as a ratio of nanograms of free beta-subunit per 1000 mIU of total beta-subunit. The ratios, analyzed by the Wilcoxon two-sample test, indicated a highly significant correlation between high ratios and the eventual diagnosis of high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease (p = 0.0019). This study suggests that the excessive production of free beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotrophin may identify patients with high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease much earlier and identify gestational trophoblastic disease in patients during pregnancy.
abstract_ja: モノクローナル抗体1E5を用いて、インタクトなヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの存在下で遊離ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニットを識別する放射免疫測定を行った。妊娠女性68例、自然寛解した胞状奇胎9例、妊娠性絨毛性疾患へ進展した胞状奇胎12例、高リスク分類の転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患5例、妊娠合併絨毛癌1例の血清を検討した。遊離β-hCGと総β-hCGの濃度を測定し、アッセイ値は1000 mIU総β-hCGあたりの遊離β-hCG(ng)の比として表した。ウィルコクソン二標本検定により解析したところ、比が高いことと高リスク妊娠性絨毛性疾患の最終診断との間に非常に有意な相関が認められた(p = 0.0019)。本研究は、遊離ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニットの過剰産生により、高リスク妊娠性絨毛性疾患をより早期に同定でき、妊娠中の妊娠性絨毛性疾患も検出できる可能性を示唆している。
